correctness.rationale: From prescribed recurrence, f_n=q^n u_n with 3-periodic u_{3j+1}=1,u_{3j+2}=t,u_{3j+3}=−(t+1). General binomids equal q^{k(n−k)} t^{E2} (−t−1)^{E0}; E0≥0, E2≥−1, and E2=−1 forces k,n−k≥2, hence t|q⁴ suffices. [4,2]_f=−q⁴(t+1)/t gives necessity using gcd(t,t+1)=1. Index pair f4/f2=q²/t gives t|q² necessity, and m mod3 case analysis suffices. Independently checked 156 (q,t) pairs through n=12 by exact integer products, not only closed-form formula; inspected standalone artifacts/check.py but did not execute it unmodified.
residual_risks: No assertion of nonnegative terms or integrality at all pyramid levels; finite tests do not substitute for all-index proof.
